text: Ship's in good order, captain. Mostly.
Storm's a bad one, captain. Shall I lash the guns?
Quiet watch, captain. I'll wake you if the dead come calling.
Good, captain. Rum's flowing, pay's regular.
Fair, captain. The lads would like to sink something soon.
Better than last voyage, captain. That one had a kraken in it. Well, a big squid.
Born in Saltmarrow, raised on the docks. Signed my articles the day I could hold a pen.
Used to crew a merchantman. Got boarded. Liked the pirates better.
